headword: {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}

definitions.explanation: Income received outside of one's regular salary or expected earnings, such as bonuses, freelance payments, gifts of money, or lottery winnings.

examples.japanese: {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went on a trip because I had some extra income.

examples.japanese: {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ことにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make it a rule to put extra income into savings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Extra income from side jobs may also be subject to tax returns.

notes:
USAGE:
Composed of ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧ (temporary, extraordinary) + ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧ (income). Covers any non-regular income such as bonuses, freelance pay, inheritance, or lottery winnings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have extra income)
- {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain extra income)
- ⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧{臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう} (unexpected windfall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不労所得|ふろうしょとく}: unearned income — income without labor (investments, rent)
- ⟦{副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}→副収入：21129_fukushuunyuu⟧: supplementary income — regular income from a side source
